scope: Annotation-only development prescreen of VT-Tiny-MOT train2017 thermal channel 01; no image download, model output reading, GPU inference, or new method.

split.role: extra development only; not official validation or test

eligibility.frame_key: numeric raw filename stem (mot_frame_id cross-check), not compacted frame_id
eligibility.visibility: annotated presence only; schema has no visibility/occlusion field; raw visual verification pending

windows.block_alignment: four consecutive disjoint 40-frame blocks for 160 frames, three for 120; compare all adjacent pairs; each block has 39 internal one-frame differences and 35 five-frame differences

motion_statistics.coordinate_system: image bbox centers x+w/2, y+h/2; px/frame, no camera compensation
motion_statistics.robust_speed: median of the 35 within-block norms of center[t+5]-center[t], divided by 5
motion_statistics.quarter_speed: endpoint center distance / 9 in each of four disjoint 10-frame quarters
motion_statistics.net_velocity: last center minus first center, divided by 39
motion_statistics.coherence: norm of summed five-frame displacement vectors divided by sum of their norms; zero for zero path
motion_statistics.heading: atan2(net_dy,net_dx) degrees; pairwise unsigned heading angle in [0,180]

event_tags.low_moving_low: three consecutive blocks low, moving, low
event_tags.moving_low_moving: three consecutive blocks moving, low, moving

artifact_guards.reject_clip_if_any_raw_center_step_excee: max(8 px, 6 * median raw center-step length over whole clip)
artifact_guards.rationale: lag-five median, moving lower quartile, and 3/4 quarter support prevent a single coordinate jump establishing movement; raw center/box jumps reject conspicuous annotation artifacts, but do not prove annotation quality

retention.representative_event_list: first window per (sequence, numeric track_id, event_tag, length stratum), no ranking by score

selection.primary: 160-frame passing windows sorted by sequence lexicographic, track_id numeric, clip_start numeric; take first
selection.fallback: only if zero passing 160-frame windows, choose 120-frame passing windows in same order
selection.inspection_queue: first passing 160-frame window per sequence, first 12 sequences; if none use 120-frame; representatives additionally retained

limits: Image-coordinate motion is not physical motion; camera motion and actual stop/restart remain unverified.
Annotated presence is not verified continuous visibility.
Prescreen labels are annotation candidates, not established events or model failures.
No model prediction, score, mask, or error is used to choose candidates.
Rectangular segmentation is not verified pixel segmentation.
Exact sequence exclusion does not establish different capture scene or camera trajectory.
